business_problem: Sentra needed to identify, classify, and secure sensitive data across global cloud, SaaS, and on-premises environments, but Postgres limited its speed and flexibility as data volumes grew from tens of millions of assets toward petabyte scale.
solution_summary: Sentra re-architected its data security posture management platform on MongoDB Atlas after Postgres became a bottleneck for petabyte-scale discovery of sensitive data across SaaS, cloud, and on-premises environments. The team first built a shared data layer and service on top of MongoDB, then migrated customers one at a time so internal services could use a single abstraction while Atlas Search and aggregation pipelines powered fast counts, filters, and highly specific queries. Atlas's flexible schema lets Sentra add new data attributes without downtime, maintain a unified customer view across environments, and onboard every new customer directly into the cloud-native platform. With guidance from MongoDB experts, Sentra also optimized massive search indexes and disaster-recovery plans, turning MongoDB from a migration target into the operational core of a platform that classifies, maps, and protects sensitive data at enterprise scale.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores the customer and asset data that powers Sentra's security posture management platform.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas Search
solution_components.role: Runs the indexed filters, counts, and targeted lookups customers use to find sensitive data quickly.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Professional Services
solution_components.role: Helped Sentra optimize search indexes, query structure, and disaster-recovery planning as the platform scaled.

data_flow: Sentra scans data inside each customer's environment, then stores asset metadata and classifications in MongoDB Atlas. Atlas Search indexes and aggregation pipelines power the filters, counts, and queries used to map exposure, while the platform's shared data layer presents a single view across cloud, SaaS, and on-premises systems.
business_outcome: Sentra scaled from 20 million to more than 1 billion assets, shrank search indexes by 70%, and cut queries from three minutes in Postgres to one second while improving data-security visibility for enterprise customers.
